local_note: For zones and ranking, each pixel is compared with a plane fitted to the usable pixels of the same unwrapped region within a 4.1 km window around it, so the values measure motion that differs from the surroundings, not motion shared by the whole area.
colour_scale: Symmetric about zero; limit = 98th percentile of the absolute value over usable pixels, per layer.
display_note: Display images are resampled (nearest neighbour) to Web Mercator. Analysis uses the native grid only.

legend.label: Range increase
legend.description: Ground moved away from the satellite (relative).

legend.label: EXCLUDED
legend.description: No usable observation. Unobserved, not unmoved.

legend.label: Deformation zone
legend.description: Contiguous quality-approved pixels above the screening threshold.
